units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后性情比右大臣更为凶狠，听了父亲这番话，怒不可遏，答道：

en.t: The Kokiden Empress Dowager was even fiercer by nature than the Minister of the Right. When she heard these words from her father, she could not restrain her rage and replied:

units.source_text: “我的儿子空有皇上的虚名，实则自昔便受众人奚落。

en.t: “My son bears the empty title of emperor, yet in truth he has been mocked by everyone since long ago.

units.source_text: 那个退职的左大臣，不肯把掌上明珠葵姬嫁给做兄长的皇太子，偏偏把她嫁给臣籍的小弟源氏，同衾的时候这源氏还只十二岁加冠之年呢。

en.t: That retired Minister of the Left refused to marry his cherished daughter, Lady Aoi, to the elder brother, the Crown Prince, and instead deliberately married her to Genji, the younger brother reduced to commoner rank. When they shared the marriage bed, Genji was only twelve, the age of his coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 我早已有意将六妹送入宫中，却先遭受源氏侮辱。

en.t: I had long intended to send my sixth sister into the palace, but first she was dishonored by Genji.

units.source_text: 然而谁也不以为怪，大家袒护源氏。

en.t: Yet no one thought it strange; everyone shielded Genji.

units.source_text: 结果六妹不能享受女御之尊，只得屈居尚侍之位。

en.t: As a result, my sixth sister could not enjoy the honored rank of nyogo and had to settle for the lower position of naishi no kami.

units.source_text: 我常引以为恨，屡思设法使其升迁，身居后宫第一，借以清雪受辱之耻。

en.t: I have always held this as a grievance, and have often thought of finding some way to raise her rank, place her first in the women’s quarters, and thereby wash away the shame of that insult.

units.source_text: 无奈六妹不知好歹，一味倾心于自己所爱之人。

en.t: But unfortunately my sixth sister did not know what was good for her, and devoted herself only to the man she loved.

units.source_text: 六妹尚且如此，他追求斋院槿姬的谣传一定也是真的了。

en.t: Since even my sixth sister was like this, the rumor that he pursued Princess Asagao of the Kamo Shrine must surely be true as well.

units.source_text: 总之，源氏处处对朱雀帝不满，他只偏袒皇太子，巴望他早日即位。

en.t: In short, Genji is dissatisfied with Emperor Suzaku in every respect. He favors only the Crown Prince and longs for him to ascend the throne soon.
This much is easy to understand.”

units.source_text: 她侃侃直说，毫不留情，反使右大臣对源氏深感抱歉，自悔多言。

en.t: She spoke on and on with complete bluntness and no mercy at all, which instead made the Minister of the Right feel deeply sorry toward Genji and regret having said too much.

units.source_text: 他想：“我何必将此事告诉她呢？”

en.t: He thought, “Why did I have to tell her about this?”
Then he tried to smooth things over with gentle words:
